summary: Picard Medical filed an 8-K regarding a Warrant Issuance and Exchange Agreement with a holder of existing warrants. The holder surrendered warrants exercisable for 7,009,346 shares at $2.675/share in exchange for new warrants exercisable for up to 10,000,000 shares at $0.35/share, eliminating forced exercise and anti-dilution provisions. The exchange is conditioned on closing of an S-1 offering. This is a warrant restructuring, not a capital returns initiative, as no cash changes hands and the net effect is dilutive.
